title: Essenza
problem: A catalog is hard to judge when products, variants, and a demo purchase sit in separate sketches.
approach: The studio put those pieces in one concept shop. It is not a commercial client and it records no sales.
what_we_built: A catalog laid out for browsing
Variants shown on the same product
A demonstration purchase path, with no real payment

title: Atelier
problem: Daily work is hard to read when tasks and decisions have no shared picture.
approach: The studio drew an internal interface so a person can see the work. It is not a commercial client and it reports no time saved.
what_we_built: A single view of work in progress
Tasks and decisions placed where a person can find them
Labels written for the people doing the work

title: Flow
problem: A request can disappear between the first message and the next action.
approach: The studio drew the path so each step stays visible. It is not a commercial client and it reports no volume handled.
what_we_built: A path from the first request to the next action
Steps a person can follow
The whole path left visible

title: Forma
problem: A brand is hard to judge when type and motion live in separate samples.
approach: The studio put type and motion in one visual language. It is not a commercial client and it reports no recognition.
what_we_built: A type system for the concept
Motion used as part of the same language
A visual study, not a campaign

title: Prospettiva
problem: A long story is hard to follow when the page has no depth and no path.
approach: The studio tried a reading experience with depth and narrative. It is not a commercial client and it reports no readership.
what_we_built: A page built for reading
Depth used to separate parts of the story
A narrative path through the concept

title: Omni Portal
problem: An idea is hard to show while it is still changing form.
approach: The studio made an original digital sculpture about that change. It is an internal concept, not a commercial client, and it reports no audience.
what_we_built: A single visual piece
A sequence that shows an idea changing
No product claim attached to the piece

title: Casa Luce
problem: Stay requests arrive by phone, message, and portals, and the same facts are repeated for each guest.
approach: The studio drew one page for the place and a request a person confirms. It is not a commercial client and it promises no stays.
what_we_built: A page with rooms, services, and images
A stay request, with availability left for a person to confirm
Notes before arrival, reviewed by a person

title: Tavola
problem: Calls and messages cut into service, and requests and preferences get lost.
approach: The studio connected the room to a menu, a table request the staff confirms, and notes that wait for approval. It is not a commercial client and it promises no covers.
what_we_built: A menu that can be updated and opened from a QR
A table request confirmed by the staff
Content held until a person approves it

title: Studio Forma
problem: Files and feedback sit in email and folders, so the status of an engagement is hard to see.
approach: The studio drew a site, a brief, an agenda, and a shared area with approvals. It is not a commercial client and it reports no engagements won.
what_we_built: A site and a structured brief
An agenda with confirmations
A shared area with access and approvals
